title: Crystal Garden
description: Generative crystal & frost growth — watch dendrites, minerals, coral and frost ferns form via diffusion-limited aggregation.
concept: A real-time diffusion-limited-aggregation (DLA) crystal grower. Wandering particles drift inward from a spawn ring and freeze onto the growing cluster, colored by growth age. Four growth modes reshape the underlying physics — six-fold mirror symmetry for snowflake dendrites, four-fold reflection for faceted minerals, unmirrored loose sticking for coral reefs, and directional gravity-biased sticking for frost ferns. Tap anywhere to plant extra nucleation seeds and watch clusters merge.
features: 4 growth modes with distinct symmetry & stickiness physics (Dendrite, Mineral, Coral, Frost)
5 age-gradient color palettes (Aurora, Ember, Glacier, Toxic, Rose Quartz)
Tap/click anywhere to place extra nucleation seed points
Density slider controls active particle swarm size
Save crystal thumbnails to a localStorage gallery, click to reload a recipe
Export current crystal as a high-res PNG
Shareable URL hash encodes mode + palette + seed + density for deterministic regrowth

interaction.mouse: Click/drag over the canvas to plant new crystal nucleation seeds
interaction.click: Switch growth mode, palette, adjust density, save/export/share via the bottom glass panel
interaction.touch: Tap to plant seeds; all controls are touch-friendly on mobile
interaction.keyboard: R = new crystal, S = export PNG, 1-4 = switch growth mode
